svg.aria-label: What Love builds: computer vision, NL-to-SQL, real-time voice, backends
svg.title: What Love builds: computer vision, NL-to-SQL, real-time voice, backends

g.text: Segmentation, homography and CLIP search on 4 GB GPUs.
Hindi, English and Hinglish questions answered from live data.
Dual-agent voice and chat, end-to-end latency under 500 ms.
FastAPI, WebSockets and Docker on edge and cloud.
Fitting the model to the hardware,
not the hardware to the model.
people can act on straight away.
